Big Bench Audio contains 1,000 audio files representing questions designed to test the intelligence of models.

The questions are based on four categories of the Big Bench Hard dataset (250 questions each) and were generated using 23 synthetic voices from top-ranked text to speech models in the Artificial Analysis Text to Speech Arena.
Our speech reasoning benchmark evaluates the ability of native audio models to answer reasoning-based questions.
Native audio models are provided with an input audio file and are expected to generate an output audio.
The judge model is provided with the candidate answer, official answer and original question as context and is prompted to label the candidate answer as correct or incorrect.
Formal Fallacies (250 questions): Determine whether an argument presented informally can be logically deduced from the provided context.
Navigate (250 questions): Determine whether a series of navigation steps returns the agent to the starting point.
Object Counting (250 questions): Count the number of a specific item class given a collection of possessions.
Web of Lies (250 questions): Evaluate the truth value of a Boolean function expressed as a natural-language word problem.
